anomalies.observed: PCA9685PW pin 1 (A0 address-select) is tied to the +3.3V net. The other address-select pins A1 (pin 2), A2 (pin 3), A3 (pin 4), A4 (pin 5) and A5 (pin 24) are all on the GND net, so only A0 is high.
anomalies.expected: With A0 high and the remaining address pins low, the PCA9685 responds at 0x41, not the 0x40 stated in the spec. For 0x40 all address-select pins must be tied to GND, as the INA219 (A0/A1 on GND, also 0x40) is.

evidence.quote: PWM/servo driver | FCCPeripherals | NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40

anomalies.impact: The FCC's I2C writes to address 0x40 receive no acknowledge, so the PWM driver never receives its configuration and no servo PWM outputs are generated.
